newsitem.title: UK: UK to introduce right to interest on late payments.
newsitem.headline: UK to introduce right to interest on late payments.

text.p: The government said on Wednesday it would introduce a bill giving firms a statutory right to claim interest on late payments.
It said a number of business surveys had consistently shown that more than 60 percent of small businesses supported a legal right to claim interest.
Critics of the plan, however, contend that large companies would punish smaller suppliers that invoked the right by taking their business elsewhere.

The government said it would consult with business on the best way of introducing the legislation, which would provide for interest to be claimed on the late payment of commercial debts above a certain threshold.
The manifesto on which Labour won the May 1 election also proposed requiring large firms to say in their annual reports how many of their bills they paid late in the previous year.
It also said government departments and local authorities should be required to pay their bills on time.
